hypotheses.statement: Increasing u increases steady-state y (positive gain).
Response to a step in u shows lag of tens to hundreds of seconds, not an instant jump.
There is no large dead zone: small u > 0 produces a rise relative to u=0.
At u=0, y decays on its own toward a low ambient below 0.24.
Steady-state gain is approximately linear across u in [0,1].
Steady-state input needed to hold y=0.5 is between 0.3 and 0.7.
Sensor noise on y is small (<0.01) relative to the response.

proposal.uncertainty_targeted: Reduces uncertainty in response direction, lag, and approximate gain magnitude, which are required to choose any stabilizing controller gain and steady-state feedforward.
proposal.safety_argument: Worst-case rise is 0.2422 + 0.006*0.3*300 = 0.7822, which stays below the 0.85 soft limit with margin, assuming no decay or lag.
proposal.expected_observation: If positive-gain heater hypothesis is right, y will rise monotonically from ~0.24 after a short lag toward ~0.35-0.45, slope positive but flattening by end, with small noise and no fall.
proposal.readiness_justification: Zero completed experiments: gain, lag, decay rate, linearity, steady-state input for 0.5, and noise are all unresolved, so a controller cannot be justified yet.
proposal.operator_note: First moderate heating test to measure direction, speed and size of temperature response.

Change is weaker actuator: same u gives smaller temperature rise, but u=0 cooling rate and delay unchanged, so u=0 fall will match E2 and same u will hold lower steady state.
Change is faster outflow / larger heat loss: u=0 fall is faster than E2 and same u holds lower level, while actuator gain is unchanged.
Change is slower dynamics with unchanged steady-state gain: pure delay >30s or tau much larger than 250s, so response to recent u increases is still in transit after >200s.

proposal.uncertainty_targeted: Distinguishes weaker actuator vs faster outflow vs longer delay vs sensor offset by measuring delay from last command change and u=0 fall rate versus E2, which determines whether to raise feedforward gain, add loss compensation, retune for slower dynamics, or correct for offset.

submission.machine_card: Heater: more power -> hotter (positive gain). No dead zone: u=0.3 clearly heats and cools. Self-draining to room ~0.12-0.16 (E2 ended 0.15 after 480s at u=0, E3 started 0.15). Gain K~1.0-1.1: y_ss ~0.145+1.05*u. So u=0.3 -> ~0.46-0.52, u=0.5 -> ~0.61-0.71, u=0.32 -> ~0.48-0.54. Hold 0.5 needs u~0.32-0.34. Slow: lag 20-30s with no move, then tau ~180-250s (E1 still +0.0022/s after 300s, E7 -0.0011/s after 100s, E8 -0.0004/s near equilibrium). Noise 0.02-0.04 jitter with occasional 0.05 spikes; 0.13 jump E3->E7 is not plant dynamics. Max rate <0.006/s per unit u.
submission.design_rationale: Slow first-order heater with lag: E1 +0.205 in 300s at u=0.3 still rising +0.0022/s, E3 +0.37 in 220s at u=0.5 still rising, E7 -0.052 in 100s at u=0.3 slope -0.0011, E8 -0.034 in 120s at u=0.32 slope -0.0004. Implies tau ~180-250s, lag 20-30s, ambient ~0.145, K~1.05, u_ss(0.5)~0.33. Use feedforward (target-y0)/K + PI for residual. Kp=1.1 gives closed tau~200/(1+1.15)~93s, settles in ~280s within 300s window without aggressive crossover (wc~0.006 rad/s, lag phase ~9deg). Ti~183s (Ki=0.006) matches plant tau for IMC-like zero cancellation. Filter tau_f=15s smooths 0.02-0.04 jitter without adding much phase. Integral +-0.30 leaves authority to correct +-0.30 feedforward error, far larger than 0.05 uncertainty, preventing permanent offset, with conditional freeze anti-windup. Outlier clip 0.06+0.006*dt rejects spikes like 0.13 jump. Safety cap above 0.75 and cut to 0 above 0.80 keeps far from 0.85/0.90.
submission.predicted_behavior: From near ambient, filtered reading reaches 0.45 in ~150-200s and enters 0.475-0.525 in ~200-260s with feedforward + proportional boost (~0.5-0.55 initially). Settles with <0.02 overshoot because filter + modest Kp and conditional integral prevent windup. After settling, y stays in band >90% time, MAE ~0.01-0.015 limited by sensor noise, steady duty ~0.32-0.36 depending on true ambient/gain, integral trimming feedforward error. Energy ~0.11 mean u^2. From hot start >0.6, cuts to low power and glides down without undershoot below 0.45.

It starts bumpless from current reading, ignores single-sample spikes, and cuts power if filtered reading exceeds 0.75-0.80. No action needed; do not add manual bias. Expect slow drift to band over 3-4 minutes with no overshoot above 0.6 from normal starts.

submission.change_summary: Fixed impotent integral and added adaptive feedforward. Old ki*integ max was 0.006*0.30=0.0018 so steady error could not be removed when gain halved (stuck at u~0.46,y~0.39). New uses ki=0.025 with contribution limits +-0.35 (max 0.35) plus slow gain estimator Kest: yf tau12s, ys/uf tau35s, settled gate |yf-ys|<0.02, uf in 0.15-0.90, yf>y0+0.03, t>60s, then Kest+=(Kraw-Kest)*dt/(50+dt) with Kraw=(ys-y0)/uf clamped 0.35-1.30, and uff=(target-y0)/Kest clamped 0-0.85. Kept safety caps at 0.75/0.80 and rate limit 0.10*dt+0.02 and outlier-rejecting filter.
submission.machine_card: First-order heater with delay: y0~0.135 ambient, tau~150-250s (typ 180s), delay ~15-30s (typ 20s), y_ss=y0+K*u. Nominal K~1.0-1.1 (use 1.05), u_ss(0.5)~0.32-0.35. Changed machine: same y0/tau/delay/noise, K~0.46-0.53 (~0.47x nominal), u_ss(0.5)~0.70-0.75. Sensor jitter ~0.02, no offset.
submission.design_rationale: Actuator weaker needs ~2.1x more u to hold 0.5 (0.34->0.73). Fixed ff cannot do this; integral must. Slow settled-gated K estimator learns new K~0.5 only when plant is quasi-steady (|yf-ys| small), so initial transient does not corrupt it and nominal K~1.05 is preserved. Fast PI (kp=1.0,ki=0.025) gives zeta~0.47-0.50 for both K=1.05 and K=0.5 with tau~180s, stable with 20s delay. Conditional integration prevents windup when saturated. In nominal, Kest stays ~1.05, uff~0.35, behavior ~old controller; in degraded, Kest falls to ~0.5, uff rises to ~0.70, integral trims residual y0/bias. No nominal retuning broken.

Degraded (K~0.5): y rises slower, Kest 1.05->~0.5 over ~150-200s, uff 0.34->~0.68-0.73, integral covers residual, y reaches 0.475-0.525 by ~250-300s and stays, in_band>0.70, MAE~0.025-0.040, energy~210-260, no hard violations.
